statusNote: Proposed v05 candidate. It replaces only the four free-flow car legs of the v03 candidate with measured 2025 trip-duration medians from official city trip-record datasets. The runtime does not read this file and v02 stays active. The arrival-side allowance is still unsourced, so the M2 door-to-door route-figures gate stays OPEN.
respondsTo: docs/qa/rpg-2-star-ocean-the-second_m2-nyc-chicago-typical-door-to-door_resume-attempt-blocked_qa-note_m2-v04_20261015-224916-c4e1a7b2.md (section 3 items E1, E2, E3; section 4 plans P1, P2, P3)
scope: Changes only accessMinutes and egressMinutes. Flight block medians (165 / 136) and checkInAndWaitMinutes (120) are carried unchanged from v03. doorToDoorAllowanceMinutes stays 0 and is NOT a claim that the arrival side takes no time.
assumptions: Car legs are zone-to-zone measured trip durations, not point-to-point. NYC: TLC taxi zone 231 'TriBeCa/Civic Center' (contains City Hall Park point -74.00708, 40.71205) and zone 138 'LaGuardia Airport' (contains the v03 LGA B departures curb point). Chicago: community area 32 'LOOP' (contains -87.6297746, 41.881144) and 76 'OHARE' (contains both v03 ORD T1 curb points). All four memberships were checked by server-side point-in-polygon, not from memory.
Window is calendar year 2025 (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31, local pickup/start time), the latest full year released in all three datasets on 2026-10-15.

NYC duration = yellow taxi (tpep_dropoff_datetime - tpep_pickup_datetime) pooled with HVFHV trip_time (pickup to dropoff). Matched shared HVFHV rides are excluded. Chicago duration = taxi trip_seconds. Rows with duration <= 0 or > 180 min are excluded and counted.

Durations are meter/app-trip time only. They exclude taxi-stand queue, app-ride wait, curb dwell, and the offset between zone interiors and the exact scene points or terminal curbs. Chicago taxi trips cover all O'Hare terminals; NYC rows cover all LGA terminals.
Chicago Transportation Network Providers (rideshare) trips were NOT included: the 2025 TNP query (6dvr-xwnh) timed out after 300 s on 2026-10-15. Chicago legs are taxi-only.
Primary candidate uses all-hours medians. weekday 07:00-19:00 medians are given as a sensitivity row. The time-of-day policy is a creator decision (v04 note E6).

Component minutes are rounded to whole minutes before summing, as the runtime sums integer fields. candidateTotalFromRawComponents shows the unrounded sum. Totals are 'sum of component medians', not the median of a door-to-door total.
